## Import



TKE kubernetes control plane log can be imported using the clusterId#clusterType#componentName, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Kubernetes/controlPlaneLog:ControlPlaneLog example cls-rng1h5ei#tke#cluster-autoscaler
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
